source.record_description: Experimental condition datasets (for example temperature and pressure) for particulate sampling systems.
source.context_report_title: D4 -- Report on the development, comparison and validation of sampling systems (using back-to-back sampling and repeated sampling)

pre_access_attestation.known_summary_boundary: The public D4 report identifies experiment 5 as an H70 vehicle particulate-sampling fill and publishes aggregate experiment descriptors. Those descriptors are not scored as holdout outcomes.
pre_access_attestation.independence_boundary: The selected Group D file is a different record, apparatus and experiment from the previously inspected Group B Hy-SaM workbooks, but it is from the same MetHyTrucks campaign family.

frozen_selection.selection_rule: Evaluate this exact file once. Retain an intake or model failure; do not replace it with the companion mass-summary workbook or another experiment.

required_semantics: mass flow or independently checkable transferred mass
measurement_only_intake.failure_rule: If required semantics or units cannot be established from the workbook and already-public official documentation, record INELIGIBLE_METADATA without inventing a mapping or imputing a required trace.

frozen_model.initial_state_policy: first eligible measured pressure and mean eligible measured tank-temperature sample
frozen_model.mass_flow_policy: use the measured mass-flow boundary after a pre-fill idle-baseline subtraction only when an idle baseline exists; otherwise use the published raw flow channel without fitted scaling
frozen_model.inlet_temperature_policy: use measured delivered-gas temperature as a boundary input when available; otherwise the model score is ineligible rather than estimated
frozen_model.upstream_pressure_policy: use measured upstream/nozzle pressure only for inlet enthalpy evaluation when its units are established
frozen_model.ambient_temperature_policy: use a clearly identified ambient channel when present; otherwise use the first measured tank temperature and label the approximation
frozen_model.tank_geometry_policy: A primary quantitative score requires independently published or workbook-embedded vehicle internal volume and tank type. Do not infer volume from transferred mass, final pressure or any scored outcome.

decision_rule: PASS requires eligible channel semantics, independently established geometry and all four frozen error limits. Any missing requirement is retained as FAIL or INELIGIBLE; thresholds and the selected file cannot change after workbook access.

full_loop_gate_impact.reason: One operational trace cannot meet the frozen full-loop cohort requirement of at least eight independent cases and it does not promise controller, cascade-bank or compressor-state channels.
full_loop_gate_impact.positive_value: A completed eligible run would add the first prospectively frozen public physical-HRS vehicle-fill transient for the tank boundary; an ineligible result will still document the exact public-data gap without selective replacement.

claim_boundary: This protocol can support a bounded single-event operational trace result. It cannot certify station safety, validate cascade dispatch, establish emergency-response effectiveness, or by itself close the IJHE full-loop external-validation gate.
